# Conditional / scaling minion modifiers

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, modifier, condition

## Derived / confirmed formula

Minion mods that need a condition/scaling clause now resolve their base to minion_* and scale via the aggregator's per/gate condition_expr. Covers the 6 minion core talents (Dirty Tricks per Ailment type, Indifference per 5 remaining Energy cap 50%, Reflection per Aura type, Talons per-Growth, Focused Strike at-center, Queer Angle Lucky). Player-numeric conditions (remaining_energy, aura_type_count, ailment_type_count) reach minions unchanged; Growth-scaling is applied in the minion pass.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped, unverified. Per-Growth Ultimate AS/CS stats wired but inert until the magi Ultimate (Full Bloom) is modeled.

## Implementation (engine model)

server._COND_PATTERNS (per Blessing / per remaining Energy + cap / per Aura type / when you have N Minions / widen each|every ailment). New conditions in data/conditions.json (remaining_energy, aura_type_count derived from active auras, active_minions, recently_summoned_minion, minion_low_life). mod_parser matchers: per-20/40-Growth (Talons), at-center (Focused Strike), leading-minion peel (Reflection 'Minions +N% …'). minion_offense folds per-Growth (via fold_spirit_magi_pools, scaled by Growth) + at-center (Area-scoped, full uptime).
